_doc: Curated source list for tokenmin's detector-research watcher. PRs welcome to add a source — open an issue first so we can confirm the trust signal. Each source declares its tier (1=Anthropic first-party, auto-trusted; 2=verified community, curated allowlist) and a trust_reason that has to be more than vibes.
_todo: code.claude.com/docs and platform.claude.com/docs were tried as html-index sources on 2026-05-24 and removed: the docs URL structure has no article-vs-nav distinction, so the watcher fired on section landing pages. They need a content-diff watcher (hash specific high-value pages like /docs/en/whats-new, /docs/en/best-practices, /docs/en/costs and surface diffs), not a URL-discovery watcher. Filed for follow-up.

sources.trust_reason: 'All About Claude' Medium publication — cited in scanner#15 as evidence for the 90% token-reduction pattern. Publication-level editorial curation. Curated allowlist.

sources.name: holm-blog
sources.trust_reason: Holm's Claude Code token-waste / context-hygiene series — cited in scanner#15 as the evidence base for cache-thrash, peak-hours, and late-night detectors. Feed also covers broader AI-governance topics, so we filter to Claude-optimization keywords.

sources.name: mindstudio-blog
sources.trust_reason: MindStudio's MCP token-overhead piece quantified the 18k tokens/turn cost of zombie MCP servers — cited in scanner#15 as the evidence base for the mcp_zombie_servers detector. Site publishes high-volume AI content, so we filter to Claude-optimization keywords.
